sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Apply the stated maximum as a cap in formula (4.2): bind the raw value (?a * ?power + ?b) / 1000, then compare c_d within tolerance to IF(raw > 1, 1, raw), while retaining sh:maxInclusive 1. The current raw-formula equality plus a separate maximum makes cases with a calculated value above 1 impossible instead of yielding c_d = 1.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The required mcrPower_kW operand is omitted: the formula instead uses the unrelated unitless shipSizeEngineOutputCoefficientK. Use the supplied continuousPropulsionPowerAvailableInIce quantity on the ship with unit KiloW as the engine-output operand (and retain the tolerance-based decimal comparison and cd <= 1 constraint); do not allow an unconnected coefficient-K value to stand in for the required power input.

The candidate enforces only cd = (a*k+b)/1000 and cd <= 1; it omits the principal design-pressure formula. Add the supplied canonical iceLoadAreaFactorCa operand with an exact-one unitless decimal QuantityValue constraint on its required owner, and extend the bounded formula validation so icePressure approximately equals shipSizeEngineOutputFactorCd * iceClassFactorCp * iceLoadAreaFactorCa * nominalIcePressureP0, using a decimal tolerance rather than exact equality. Retain the existing cd maximum and tolerant cd derivation, preferably combining both derived checks into one bounded SPARQL constraint.

Apply the stated maximum as a cap in formula (4.2): bind the raw value (?a * ?power + ?b) / 1000, then compare c_d within tolerance to IF(raw > 1, 1, raw), while retaining sh:maxInclusive 1. The current raw-formula equality plus a separate maximum makes cases with a calculated value above 1 impossible instead of yielding c_d = 1.
